title: blur_gate.py hardcodes balance/view numbers that the game single-sources (ODN-5 tension, silent gate drift)
evidence: tools/blur_gate.py:45-47: `TILE_PX = 26` / `WORLD_W_TILES, WORLD_H_TILES = 40, 30` / `WIN_W, WIN_H = 1280, 720` and SPAWNS table at :33; app/render/view.odin view_compute: `v.tile_px = f32(bal.tile_px)` / `v.world_w = f32(bal.map_w_tiles) * v.tile_px`; data/balance.json:77: `"tile_px": 26`; demos/terminal_types.dem:25-31 carries the same spawn rows the SPAWNS table restates.
detail: The committed acceptance gate re-implements the camera fit and restates balance numbers and the demo spawn table in Python. A future balance.json or demo edit silently desyncs the sampler — wrong pixels, misleading pass/fail, no error.
recommended_fix: Load tile_px/map dims from data/balance.json and parse spawn rows from demos/terminal_types.dem instead of hardcoding; keep the calibration run as backstop.

title: draw_router duplicates the blit argument expressions that draw_building hoists to locals
evidence: view.odin:989-990: `dst, ok := sprite_blit_dst(&v.sprites, sprite_index_puck(port_capacity), c, sprite_puck_target(v, port_capacity))` / `sprite_blit(&v.sprites, sprite_index_puck(port_capacity), c, sprite_puck_target(v, port_capacity))` — vs the sibling pattern at view.odin:714-715: `dst, ok := sprite_blit_dst(&v.sprites, idx, c, target)` / `sprite_blit(&v.sprites, idx, c, target)` (idx/target hoisted at 707-708).
detail: sprite_index_puck and sprite_puck_target are each evaluated twice; editing one line but not the other silently desyncs the tier-wash footprint from the blit — the exact drift sprite_blit_dst was extracted to prevent.
recommended_fix: Hoist `idx := sprite_index_puck(port_capacity)` and `target := sprite_puck_target(v, port_capacity)` to locals, mirroring draw_building.
